headline: JOHN LEWIS SCORED 5.6 STARS ON SYSTEM1, ITS BEST CHRISTMAS ADVERT SINCE 2019, AND 61 PERCENT OF VIEWERS CAME AWAY HAPPY, NEARLY TWICE THE BRITISH TELEVISION AVERAGE, IN THE SAME WEEK THE PUBLIC ARGUMENT DECIDED IT WAS TONE DEAF
deck: Yesterday this brief ran the John Lewis advert as a failure and said plainly that nobody had published a single performance number.  This morning somebody did, and it points the other way.  System1's pre-test puts the 2026 film at its best score in seven years and says 61 percent of viewers finished it feeling happy.  The argument on Mumsnet and in the opinion columns has not changed.  Both things are now true at once, and the gap between them is the most useful thing in today's issue, because it is the gap most brand teams react to without noticing which side of it they are standing on.
tldr: System1 scored the John Lewis Christmas advert at 5.6 Stars, its best since 2019, with 61 percent of viewers feeling happy, nearly twice the British television average, in the same week the public argument called it tone deaf, and the real finding is a four-year run of 3.6, 4.6, 5.1 and 5.6 under the same agency.  Decide now what evidence would make you change a piece of seasonal work, and hold creative decisions for 72 hours after a launch so the measured read exists before the loud one moves your plan.

An audible brand mention added 22 points of brand recall across more than 15,000 sponsored creator assets in Kantar's analysis, and only 49 percent of them say the brand name aloud, while creator content beats digital advertising norms on attention and trails them by 71 percentile points on branding.  Add four non-negotiable lines to every creator brief this week: the name is said aloud once in the creator's own words, the product is handled on camera, the packaging is legible in one shot, and one benefit is stated.

Sinclair booked 136 million dollars of political advertising against 6 million a year earlier while its core advertising fell 4 percent, Nexstar said the political surge crowded other categories out, and Magnite's own 2027 guidance prices the absence of political money at roughly five points of growth.  Quote the seller's own filing back to them this week, ask for the make-good on the six weeks you were pre-empted, and book a date in February to read their fourth-quarter numbers.

Fifty-seven percent of marketers have no clear read on whether creator spending pays back, 38 percent do not measure it against what a customer costs to acquire, and 48 percent keep creator content under 5 percent of total advertising spend.  Calculate the cost of acquiring a customer through your single biggest creator spend of the last six months, put it on one page next to the same figure for paid social and search, and take it to whoever sets the budget.

Snap's advertising revenue grew 4 percent and its brand advertising fell, while the average price of reaching a thousand people on its Spotlight creator feed rose 22 percent after it removed machine-generated and reposted video from that feed.  Ask every social and creator network what share of their feed is originally posted by the account that owns it rather than reposted or generated, and write the answer down because in six months it will be a price.

Election night across YouTube, Twitch, Rumble and Kick peaked at 3.4 million people at once and 20.87 million hours over more than 3,400 channels, against 25.79 million average viewers on six television networks, and NBC News alone took 4.39 million of those hours from three simultaneous streams whose peaks added to 667,000.  Require four numbers on every live sponsorship from now on, peak concurrents, average concurrents, hours watched and the channel count, and ask what share of last year's hours came from the single biggest channel.

Mr Carlson's Lab went from a 45,082 median to a 167,533 median across consecutive blocks of ten uploads by replacing restoration videos about specific objects with question-titled bench demonstrations of how components behave, and across eight straight uploads every outbound link in the description is his own.  If you sell test equipment, soldering gear or capacitors, offer him a funded measurement section inside that existing format with a back catalogue licence, and on your own channel rewrite your next three titles as questions your product answers on camera.
